question: Do the exposed GSE136831 macrophage RNA panel contrasts and within-IPF panel association transport descriptively to differently annotated GSE135893 macrophages?
decision: Compute a bounded external transport description using nine qualified RNA outcome genes, preserving primary Macrophage20 and all original interpretation holds.
strongest_rival: Source-site/diagnosis imbalance, annotation and capture differences, inherited cache selection and unmeasured clinical variables can produce cross-cohort differences without biological transport.
discriminator: Separate source-qualified donor comparison; exact native outcome genes; raw assay parity; fixed source annotation sensitivity and Vanderbilt common-source restriction.
exposure_record: Primary GSE136831 results and historical GSE135893 aggregate analyses are exposed. External metadata/assay qualification is exposed. Full30-symbol qualification retains a SELENOP exact-mapping hold; the nine already proposed outcome genes are uniquely mapped and match raw aggregates. No new external effect fit has run before this freeze.
biological_unit: GSE135893 Sample_Name donor. orig.ident labels and captured cells are nested identifiers, not independent biological units.
nesting_and_overlap: Published Habermann separate dataset/pipeline evidence supports a separate collection from Adams, without direct patient-identity audit. Existing Ravel reanalyses of GSE135893 reuse this same cohort and are exposed.
population_and_selection: IPF and Control donors with inherited macrophage-compartment cache floor50; exact labels Macrophages plus Proliferating Macrophages, with Macrophages alone sensitivity at floor50. No monocytes. Other diagnoses are enumerated and excluded, not relabeled. Selection manifest fixes all21eligible donors; Vanderbilt7IPF/6Control is common-source sensitivity.
contrast: IPF-Control unweighted donor mean differences for two RNA panels and ARG1; within-IPF/Control FABP4-versus-matrix Spearman correlation. All sources primary, exact Vanderbilt label sensitivity. No COPD, NAM, recipient or clinical-adjusted effect.
endpoint: Mean gene log2(1+CPM) from summed native raw UMI with full-gene denominator; ARG1 separately. Source-specific donor-level RNA measurement, not activity or secretion.
methods: Sum gene counts and all-gene totals across constituent annotations BEFORE logCPM. Use primary frozen formulas:2000donor-bootstrap contrast resamples and1000paired-bootstrap correlation resamples, seed20261029; correlation>=8varying donors and>=95%defined bootstrap draws. Record all failures. Compare to already computed GSE136831 AllMacrophages floor50 sensitivity without refitting or changing primary Macrophage20.
missingness_and_exclusions: No symbol alias substitution or missing-as-zero. External SELENOP identity marker unavailable; no proxy analysis. External age/sex and other clinical variables unqualified; no clinical adjustment. Cached fibroblast support7IPF/3Control fails the fixed>=8within-group correlation rule; no recipient fit. Vanderbilt7/6correlations likewise remain unestimated.
multiplicity: Three endpoints, two annotation definitions and two source scopes; all reported, no p-values, no multiplicity-controlled discovery.
precision_basis: Exploratory pointwise donor-bootstrap intervals, not power or effect-margin certification. Upstream50-cell selection is retained and limits generalizability.
interpretation_limit: Exposed cross-cohort RNA robustness/transport description with different annotations; not exact NAM reproduction, unexposed confirmation, mechanism, causal coupling or biological acceptance.
stop_rule: Stop if any exact donor/source/diagnosis set or required nine-symbol map changes, any raw-assay audit fails or aggregate parity fails. Preserve sparse/constant/non-estimable rows. Do not expand cohorts or relax thresholds to obtain favorable results.
amendment_reason: Separate prospective external numerical stage after assay qualification; nine-gene scope preserves the full30-symbol identity-marker hold.
